meta.name: Fedor Tsvetkov
meta.base_headline: Growth Architect | Building Scalable Marketing Systems

bullets: Architected and deployed core digital marketing infrastructure from scratch, driving a 7x increase in monthly revenue within the first 18 months.
Managed multi-channel digital performance campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads, maintaining consistent, high-converting inbound traffic funnels.
Deployed advanced AI-driven automation workflows for optimized lead processing, customer retention, and lifecycle marketing management.
Integrated proprietary CRM architecture with custom order-management systems, directly increasing LTV and repeat purchase rates.
Directed comprehensive user acquisition and performance campaigns for iOS and Android applications, specifically targeting competitive US and Western European markets.
Successfully maintained and optimized CAC within $3-$5 range in saturated, high-intent English-speaking markets.
Managed and mentored a cross-functional, agile, and distributed growth team to ensure rapid hypothesis testing and iterative execution.
Accountable for a $500K+ annual media and marketing budget across all digital and corporate channels, consistently delivering positive ROI.
Successfully transitioned a traditional, offline-heavy B2B enterprise entirely into high-performing digital inbound channels.
Scaled qualified inbound lead generation from absolute zero to 1,000+ verified leads per month via Google Ads, content marketing, and scalable SEO funnels.
Directed a comprehensive international SEO program, successfully ranking primary product pages into Top 5–50 spots for high-volume query groups.
Coordinated digital market expansion and localized strategy executions across 40+ international markets (EU, CIS, Africa) in tandem with European HQ.
